name: neozip-blockchain
description: Blockchain functionality for NeoZip and companion to neozipkit — NFT minting, verification, wallet management, OpenTimestamps

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run compile
scripts.example:timestamp: dotenv -e .env.local -e .env -- ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register --project examples/tsconfig.json examples/stamp-zip.ts examples/output/stamp.nzip examples/test-files/*
scripts.example:verify-timestamp: dotenv -e .env.local -e .env -- ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register --project examples/tsconfig.json examples/verify-zip.ts examples/output/stamp.nzip
scripts.example:upgrade: dotenv -e .env.local -e .env -- ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register --project examples/tsconfig.json examples/upgrade-zip.ts examples/output/stamp.nzip
scripts.example:verify-upgrade: node examples/ensure-stamp-upgrade-artifact.cjs && dotenv -e .env.local -e .env -- ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register --project examples/tsconfig.json examples/verify-zip.ts examples/output/stamp-upgrade.nzip
scripts.example:mint-nft: dotenv -e .env.local -e .env -- ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register --project examples/tsconfig.json examples/mint-nft.ts examples/output/stamp-upgrade.nzip
scripts.example:verify-nft: dotenv -e .env.local -e .env -- ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register --project examples/tsconfig.json examples/verify-zip.ts examples/output/stamp-upgrade-nft.nzip
scripts.example:token-service: dotenv -e .env.local -e .env -- ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register --project examples/tsconfig.json examples/token-create.ts examples/output/token-test.nzip examples/test-files/*
scripts.example:ots-stamp: ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register --project examples/tsconfig.json examples/ots-stamp-zip.ts examples/output/ots.nzip examples/test-files/*

author: NeoWare, Inc.
